name: Application listing core entity fields reconcile with authoritative API data
description:
Objective: Application listing core entity fields reconcile with authoritative API data.
Preconditions: Open Applications with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Applications.
2. Application listing core entity fields reconcile with authoritative API data.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Every first-page row shows the core fields of its own API record.
